title: China Regional Wage Data (by occupation and administrative level)

admin_code.description: GB/T 2260 administrative division code. 2 digits = province, 4 digits = prefecture-level city, 6 digits = county/district. Macro-regions (Eastern/Central/Western/Northeastern) and the national total are NOT part of GB/T 2260 -- they are NBS statistical aggregates only, so they use the synthetic prefixes CN-NAT / CN-E / CN-C / CN-W / CN-NE.

admin_level.description: 0 = national or macro-region (NBS aggregate, not a real administrative unit), 1 = province/municipality/autonomous region (31 units, GB/T 2260 2-digit), 2 = prefecture-level city (~333 units, GB/T 2260 4-digit), 3 = county/district (~2,800+ units, GB/T 2260 6-digit).

macro_region.description: NBS's own 4-way macro-region grouping used in its wage releases. Not a codified administrative level, but the finest geographic cut at which NBS publishes wage-by-occupation crosstabs.

enum: Personnel engaged in social production services and life services
Personnel engaged in production and manufacturing
occupation_category.description: NBS's 'position' (岗位) categories -- the only occupation-level breakdown NBS publishes, and only at national and macro-region level, never below.

classification_system.description: GB_T_2260 = real administrative code (province/prefecture/county). GB_T_2260_MACRO = NBS statistical aggregate (national/macro-region), not an official GB/T 2260 code.

wage_measure.description: NBS publishes three parallel wage series covering different employer populations -- they are NOT comparable to each other and must not be averaged together.

data_availability.description: Marks the finest level at which this row's figure is genuinely published. 'not_available' rows are placeholders documenting a real gap in public Chinese wage statistics -- not an error.
